q1_issues.issue: A bare mass/kind subject with a habitual simple present is a verbal generic, which the instruction set routes to an Implication rule giving each instance its own Skolem event, but the parse emits a flat event bundle instead.
The bare kind symbol salt_bloom fills the Patient role slot of that flat event, putting a class where the generic rule would bind an instance variable.
The event atoms carry the default (STV 1.0 0.99) rather than the empirical-generic 0.9 0.9 the generic reading requires.

q2_gaps: the medium/endpoint "into"-PP of a dissolution verb ("dissolves into the seawater"): the motion-result Goal presupposes an intact object relocated along a path, while the change-of-kind/phase rule explicitly bars a spatial Goal for "into" and expects the complement to name a state the subject becomes — neither fits a substance dispersing into a medium
notes: The compound decompositions are right (salt_bloom genus bloom, solid-spelled seawater genus water, noun modifiers salt/sea correctly unexposed) and "quickly" keeps its surface adverb form under Manner. Dissolve as an intransitive change-of-state undergoer correctly takes Patient rather than Agent.
